reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises for the WTaTiVZr alloy. E1 discusses twinning-induced plasticity in a different fcc medium-entropy alloy (CrCoNi) at room and cryogenic temperatures, not high-temperature bcc refractory HEAs. E2 mentions creep testing of TaTiVWZr and HfTaTiVZr but provides no data on lattice distortions, dynamic recovery, twinning, or toughness comparisons with pure tungsten. The premises thus lack specific prior evidence.
premises: Severe lattice distortions in equimolar WTaTiVZr modify dislocation mobility
Dynamic recovery and twinning delay crack initiation and enhance work-hardening
This leads to higher plastic strain and toughness vs. pure tungsten at high temperature
